text:
marta: quick kickoff — launching a customer field study with Fjord Retail. need to lock interview slots, a short quote for the web post, and legal signoff on the asset release. can folks confirm availability this week?

devin: i can run the interview. open weds/thurs afternoon PT. have a ~20min guide ready.

kai: sales can join for the interview intro. free thursday 1-3p PT. pls add me to the invite.

marta: thanks. devin — can you paste the guide here? want to make sure we capture metrics for the benchmark narrative. :memo:

devin: sure — putting draft below:

```
1) 5m intro + customer context
2) 7m deployment story (how they integrated Redwood API)
3) 5m metrics & impact (latency improvements, cost per inference, conversion lift)
4) 3m quote prompt (open-ended: "how has Redwood changed your product roadmap?")
```

benji: heads up — marketing needs a short, on-brand quote (1-2 sentences) and approval to use customer name/logo. can we get a draft quote during the call?

julia: legal — can we confirm we have the signed partner MSA and permission to publish case studies? if not, we need a quick release form. tagging @legal-bot to pull the contract.

legal-bot: Found: MSA (Fjord Retail) signed 2024-09-12. No explicit marketing release attached. Recommend using standard short release template and capturing verbal permission during the interview, followed by an email confirmation.

marta: ok plan — devin, during the call ask for verbal OK to publish quote/logo; we'll follow up with release template. can we also capture these metrics: avg latency before vs after, percent cost reduction, and monthly active user impact?

devin: noted. i'll have the metrics checklist pinned in the doc and ask the PM on the call.

kai: also flag routing for inbound leads — if the case study generates interest, please route to the Fjord deal owner (kai) and to the field marketing nurture flow. benji can you confirm the lead tags?

benji: yes — tag = fjord-retail-case, source=customer-web, route=sg-sales-kai. i'll add the nurture sequence to the SFDC lead flow once we have final publish date.

julia: quick legal ask: if they provide screenshots from their dashboard, we need a simple waiver. i'll attach the waiver to the release template.

marta: perfect. final checklist for publish prep:
- interview recorded + transcript (devin)
- 1-2 sentence quote captured on call (marta/benji)
- metrics verified and screenshots cleared (kai/julia)
- release form signed post-call (julia/legal-bot)
- lead routing tags set (benji)
- publish date + webinar plug (marketing calendar)

devin: scheduled interview: Thu 2026-03-26 13:30 PT with Fjord Retail PM + Eng. calendar invite sent. :calendar:

marta: awesome — i'll own the publish copy and webinar slot. aiming for a short launch post + 30-min webinar 2 weeks after publish.

kai: landed. i will prep a short demo to show during webinar that references the case metrics. :rocket:

julia: i'll queue the release template post-call and follow up for signature.

marta: thanks everyone. if no blockers, i'll mark this thread for status updates only. :thumbsup:

benji: :eyes: will share nurture assets once we have final publish date.

legal-bot: Action items logged: attach release template to thread; remind legal to confirm screenshot waiver after interview.
